fields.title: CIPA entity profile / search-result record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Detail-mode records (_source: S1-verne-entityview, the default) carry the full company profile flattened from CIPA's own view-tree node graph -- field names and grouping (e.g. Director/Shareholder/BeneficialOwner as lists) mirror upstream's own domain/attribute vocabulary verbatim, since CIPA exposes no traditional JSON REST API. Summary-mode records (_source: S1-verne-searchresult, when 'Fetch full company profile' is off) carry only the search-result row.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact query (name or registration number) that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-verne-entityview (full profile), S1-verne-searchresult (summary row only), or none (error record).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- not_found (search matched nothing), click_failed / detail_fetch_failed / blocked_or_transient (network or session issue).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

entityViewUrl.title: Entity profile URL
entityViewUrl.description: The public, bookmarkable CIPA entityView permalink this detail record was extracted from (works from a fresh, cookie-less session).

OldCompanyNumber.title: Old registration number
OldCompanyNumber.description: Legacy pre-migration registration number, if the entity predates CIPA's current system.

Status.title: Status
Status.description: Current register status (e.g. registered, removed, amalgamated, liquidation, judicialManagement).

EntityType.title: Entity type
EntityType.description: businessName, private, public, external, or close.

RegistrationDate.title: Registration date
RegistrationDate.description: Original registration date, as displayed by CIPA (free-text date, not normalized).

ReregistrationDate.title: Re-registration date
ReregistrationDate.description: Date the entity was re-registered under the current system, if applicable.

LastRenewalDate.title: Last/next renewal date
LastRenewalDate.description: Most recent (or upcoming) annual renewal date on file.

TotalShare.title: Total shares
TotalShare.description: Total number of issued shares, for share-capital entities.

IsExemptFromAudit.title: Exempt from audit
IsExemptFromAudit.description: Whether the entity is exempt from mandatory audit.

CompanyName.title: Company name
CompanyName.description: List with the entity's registered Name and Suffix (e.g. proprietaryLimited).

RegisteredOfficeAddress.title: Registered office address
RegisteredOfficeAddress.description: List wrapping the entity's registered PhysicalAddress record (CountryCode/CareOf/Line1/Line2/City).

PostalAddress.title: Postal address
PostalAddress.description: Postal address record, where present as its own top-level group (CountryCode/CareOf/Line1/Line2/City).

MailAddress.title: Mail address
MailAddress.description: List wrapping the entity's PostalAddress record used for correspondence.

PrincipalPlaceOfBusinessAddress.title: Principal place of business
PrincipalPlaceOfBusinessAddress.description: List wrapping the entity's principal-place-of-business PhysicalAddress record.

Director.title: Directors
Director.description: List of directors -- each an IndividualDirector (or CorporateDirector, if CIPA models a corporate director that way) with Nationality/StartDate/IndividualName/RolePostalAddress, passed through as CIPA's own node structure.

Secretary.title: Secretary
Secretary.description: List of company secretaries, same shape as Director.

Shareholder.title: Shareholders
Shareholder.description: List of shareholders, same shape as Director.

ShareAllocation.title: Share allocations
ShareAllocation.description: List of {ShareholderIds, NumberOfShares, PercentageAllocated} -- ShareholderIds cross-references a Shareholder's/BeneficialOwner's internal mro-<id>, not exposed elsewhere on the record.

BeneficialOwner.title: Beneficial owners
BeneficialOwner.description: List of ultimate beneficial owners -- each an IndividualBeneficialOwner with Nationalities/StartDate/IndividualName/RolePostalAddress/Interest (interest Type, e.g. shareholding, and Exact percentage).

Auditor.title: Auditor
Auditor.description: List of auditors, same shape as Director. Absent when IsExemptFromAudit is true.

label.title: Search result label
label.description: Summary-mode only: raw "<Name> (<CompanyNumber>)" label as shown on the CIPA search-results page.

name.title: Name
name.description: Summary-mode only: entity name parsed out of 'label'.

registrationNumber.title: Registration number
registrationNumber.description: Summary-mode only: registration number parsed out of 'label' (same value as CompanyNumber in detail mode).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both full-profile and search-summary records.
